description: Source code for handling PackedSequence operations in PyTorch, including packing, padding, and sequence manipulation functions.

methods.name: checkLongTensor
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is a 1D CPU int64 tensor.

methods.name: _pack_padded_sequence
methods.description: Packs padded sequences into a PackedSequence format, returning data and batch sizes.

methods.name: _pack_padded_sequence_backward_symint
methods.description: Backward operation for packed sequences, reconstructing the gradient tensor.

methods.name: _pad_packed_sequence
methods.description: Pads a packed sequence back into a tensor with padding.

methods.name: pad_sequence
methods.description: Pads a list of variable length sequences into a tensor with padding, either on the left or right.
